40003711.author: पदार्थः
40003711.content: ततः then, अत्र in this matter, प्रतिज्ञया by the promise, पीडितः afflicted, ऐक्ष्वाकः descendant of Ikshvaku, Dasaratha, सबाष्पं with tears, अतिनिश्श्वस्य sighing deeply, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, पुनः पुनः again and again, इदम् these words, जगाद  uttered.

40003711.author: Translation
40003711.content: Afflicted on account of the promise he had made, Dasaratha, descendant of the Ikshvakus heaved deep sighs again and again and with his eyes full of tears uttered these words to Sumantra:

40003712.author: पदार्थः
40003712.content: सूत O charioteer, राघवस्य Rama's, अनुयात्रार्थम् to follow him in his journey, रत्नसुसम्पूर्णा  including gems, चतुर्विधबला four divisions of, चमूः the army, क्षिप्रम् immediately, प्रतिविधीयताम् be arranged.

40003712.author: Translation
40003712.content: O Sumantra arrange immediately four divisions of the army, wellequipped with  precious stones to escort Rama in his journey to (the forest).

40003713.author: पदार्थः
40003713.content: वादिन्यः sweettongued, रूपाजीवाश्च beautiful courtesans, महाधनाः affluent, वणिजश्च merchants, सुप्रसारिताः with wellspread merchandise, कुमारस्य son's,  वाहिनीम् army, शोभयन्तु make it graceful.

40003713.author: Translation
40003713.content: Let the sweettongued courtesans, opulent merchants with well spreadout merchandise make the army of my son graceful.

40003714.author: पदार्थः
40003714.content: ये च whoever, एनम् this (Rama), उपजीवन्ति depend for living, वीर्यतः gallantry, यैश्च with whom, रमते used to sport, तेषाम् of all of them, बहुविधम् several kinds (of wealth), दत्त्वा having given (incentives), तान् all of them, अत्र in this entourage, नियोजय employ.

40003714.author: Translation
40003714.content: Bestow immense wealth on those who depended on Rama for their living and on the gallant youths with whom he used to sport. Send them along with the entourage.

40003715.author: पदार्थः
40003715.content: मुख्यानि main, आयुधानि च weapons, नागराः citizens, शकटानि च carts and carriages, आरण्यगोचराः wanderers in the forest, व्याधश्च fowlers, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, अनुगच्छन्तु follow.

40003715.author: Translation
40003715.content: Main weapons, citizens (bodyguards), carts, wanderers in the forest and fowlers wellacquainted with the forest shall follow Rama.

40003716.author: पदार्थः
40003716.content: मृगान् antelopes, कुञ्जरांश्च elephants, निघ्नन् while slaying, आरण्यकम् available in the forest, मधु honey, पिबंश्च while drinking, विविधाः several, नदीश्च rivers, पश्यन् while beholding, राज्यस्य of kingdom, न स्मरिष्यति he will not recollect.

40003716.author: Translation
40003716.content: Hunting the elephants and antelopes, drinking forest honey, beholding several rivers on the way, Rama will not recollect the kingdom.

40003717.author: पदार्थः
40003717.content: यः whichever, मामकः mine, धान्यकोशः च granary, धनकोशः च the treasury, तौ those, निर्जने in the desolate, वने in forest, वसन्तं living, रामम् Rama, अनुगच्छेताम् both may follow.

40003717.author: Translation
40003717.content: Let the entire contents of my granary and treasury follow Rama wherever he lives in the desolate forest.

40003718.author: पदार्थः
40003718.content: पुण्येषु holy, देशेषु places, यजन् while performing sacrifices, आप्तदक्षिणाः appropriate gifts,  विसृजंश्च liberally givng, ऋषिभिः with sages, समागम्य meeting, वने in the forest, सुखम् happily, प्रवत्स्यति he will live.

40003718.author: Translation
40003718.content: Performing sacrifices in the holy places and liberally giving appropriate gifts, Rama will live happily in the forest in the company of sages.

40003719.author: पदार्थः
40003719.content: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, भरतश्च Bharata also, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, पालयिष्यति will rule, श्रीमान्  auspicious, रामः Rama, सर्वकामैः सह with all objects of enjoyment, संसाध्यताम् furnish, इति thus spoke.

40003719.author: Translation
40003719.content: (While) mightyarmed Bharata will rule Ayodhya, Rama be furnished with all objects of enjoyment.

40003720.author: पदार्थः
40003720.content: काकुत्स्थे scion of the Kakutsthas (Dasaratha), एवम् in this way, ब्रुवति while saying, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi, भयम् fear, आगतम् entered, मुखं चापि her face also, शोषम् dryness, आगमत् obtained, स्वरश्चापि even her voice, न्यरुध्यत choked.

40003720.author: Translation
40003720.content: While Dasaratha was saying these words, Kaikeyi was gripped by fear and her face looked pale. Even her voice got choked.

40003721.author: पदार्थः
40003721.content: सा कैकेयी Kaikeyi, विषण्णा च dejected, सन्त्रस्ता frightened, परिशुष्यता  drying up, मुखेन with countenance, राजानमेव to the king alone, अभिमुखी facing the king, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40003721.author: Translation
40003721.content: The dejected and frightened Kaikeyi with a dry countenance, looked at the king and said:

40003722.author: पदार्थः
40003722.content: साधो O virtuous one, गतजनम् abandoned by men, शून्यम् empty (of wealth), निरास्वाद्यतमम्  incapable of being tasted (enjoyed), राज्यम् kingdom, पीतमण्डाम् essence evaporated, सुराम् इव like wine, भरतः Bharata, नाभिपत्स्यते will not receive.

40003722.author: Translation
40003722.content: O virtuous king Bharata will not take charge of the kingdom abandoned by men, drained of wealth and incapable of being enjoyed, like wine with its essence evaporated.

40003723.author: पदार्थः
40003723.content: कैकेय्याम् when Kaikeyi, मुक्तलज्जायाम् shameless, अतिदारुणम् terribly cruel, वदन्त्याम्  speaking, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, आयतलोचनाम् largeeyed woman, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच said.

40003723.author: Translation
40003723.content: King Dasaratha heard the terribly cruel and shameless words of that largeeyed Kaikeyi, and said:

40003724.author: पदार्थः
40003724.content: हिते O brutal one, मा me, धुरि in the yoke, नियुज्य having yoked, वहन्तम् while drawing, किम् why, माम् me, तुदसि goading, अनार्ये O vile one, आरब्धम् commenced, कृत्यम् act, पूर्वम् earlier, किम् why, न उपारुधः did not prevent.

40003724.author: Translation
40003724.content: O brutal Kaikeyi, you fastened me to the yoke and when I am drawing forward, why do you beat me? O vile woman why did  you not prevent me in the beginning itself?

40003725.author: पदार्थः
40003725.content: वराङ्गना that lovely woman, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, क्रोधसंयुक्तम् wrathful, तस्य that Dasaratha's, उक्तम् uttered, एतत् all these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, द्विगुणम् doubled, कृद्धा furious, राजानम् to the king, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40003725.author: Translation
40003725.content: At these wrathful words of Dasaratha, Kaikeyi with redoubled fury replied to the king:

40003726.author: पदार्थः
40003726.content: तव in your, वंशे एव dynasty itself, सगरः Sagara, असमञ्जः इति as Asamanjasa, ख्यातम्  wellknown, ज्येष्ठपुत्रम् eldest son, उपारुधत् was prevented (from assuming the kingdom),  अयम् this Rama also, तथा in the same way, गन्तुम् to go, अर्हति is worthy of.

40003726.author: Translation
40003726.content: In your own dynasty  king Sagara prevented his wellknown eldest son Asamanjasa (from enjoying the kingdom). Rama also should depart in the same manner.

40003727.author: पदार्थः
40003727.content: एवम् in this way, उक्तः having been told, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, धिक् इत्येव             'shame' only, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वः all, जनः people, व्रीडितः were ashamed, सा च Kaikeyi, तम् that one, नावबुध्यत did not perceive.

40003727.author: Translation
40003727.content: Hearing the words of Kaikeyi, Dasaratha could say only 'shame'. All the people felt ashamed, but Kaikeyi could not understand this.

40003728.author: पदार्थः
40003728.content: तत्र present there, वृद्धः the aged, नामतः by name, सिद्धार्थो नाम named Siddartha, शुचिः holy, राज्ञः king, बहुमतः favourite, महामात्रः minister, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40003728.author: Translation
40003728.content: An aged minister named Siddhartha who justified his name, highly respected by the king said this to Kaikeyi:

40003729.author: पदार्थः
40003729.content: दुर्मतिः wickedminded, असमञ्जः तु as for Asamanjasa, पथि on the street, क्रीडतः playing, बालकान् children, गृहीत्वा seizing, सरय्वा: Sarayu's, अप्सु in waters, प्रक्षिपन् while hurling, तेन with that, रमते amused.

40003729.author: Translation
40003729.content: That wickedminded Asamanjasa used to seize the children playing on the street and amuse himself by hurling them in the waters of river Sarayu.

40003730.author: पदार्थः
40003730.content: तम् them, दृष्ट्वा on watching, सर्वे all, नागराः people of the city, कृद्धाः enraged, राजानम् to the king, अब्रुवन् spoke, राष्ट्रवर्धन O enhancer of (prosperity of) the kingdom, एकम् one, असमञ्जम् Asamanjasa, अस्मान् वा or us, वृणीष्व choose.

40003730.author: Translation
40003730.content: Watching it, all the enraged citizens said to the king, 'O enhancer of the prosperity of the kingdom, either you choose Asamanjasa or us'.

40003731.author: पदार्थः
40003731.content: ततः then, राजा king, तान् to them, उवाच said, इदं भयम् this fear, किन्निमित्तम्  why?, राज्ञा by the king, सम्पृष्टाः having been asked, ताः those, प्रकृतयश्चापि subjects also, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रुवन् said.

40003731.author: Translation
40003731.content: The king  then asked them, 'Why this fear?'. And the citizens responded:

40003732.author: पदार्थः
40003732.content: उद्भ्रान्तचेतनः with an insane mind, एषः this one, क्रीडतः while playing, बालान् young ones, नः our, पुत्रान् sons, सरय्वाम् in Sarayu river, प्रक्षिपन् while throwing, मौर्ख्यात् in his insanity, अतुलाम्  incomparable, प्रीतिम् pleasure, अश्नुते deriving.

40003732.author: Translation
40003732.content: That insane (Asamanjasa) while throwing our children who were playing around into Sarayu river in his insanity derived incomparable pleasure'.

40003733.author: पदार्थः
40003733.content: सः नराधिपः that  king, तेषां प्रकृतीनाम् of those subjects, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard,  तासाम् to all of them, प्रियचिकीर्षया with the intention of pleasing them, अहितम् malevolent, तं पुत्रम् that son, तत्याज banished.

40003733.author: Translation
40003733.content: That king (Sagara) heard the words of the citizens and with the intention of doing good to them, banished that malevolent son.

40003734.author: पदार्थः
40003734.content: पिता father, Sagara, भार्यम् to (his sons's) wife, सपरिच्छदम् with the clothes on them (then their, तम् him, शीघ्रम् without delay, यानम् in a carriage, आरोप्य got him placed, अयम् this one, यावज्जीवम् for life, विवास्यः इति shall be banished, स्वान् his servants, अन्वशात् ordered.

40003734.author: Translation
40003734.content: Then the father made him and his wife climb a carriage with the clothes they had at the time on them and at once ordered his servants to banish him for life.

40003735.author: पदार्थः
40003735.content: स: he, पापकर्मकृत् यथा like an evildoer, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, अनुचरन् wandering about, सः he, फालपिटकम् a spade and a basket, गृह्य holding, गिरिदुर्गाणि impenetrable mountains, अलोडयत् spent digging.

40003735.author: Translation
40003735.content: Like an evildoer wandering about in different directions, holding a spade and a basket in his hand, he went about digging the impenetrable mountains.

40003736.author: पदार्थः
40003736.content: सुधार्मिकः highly righteous, सगरः राजा king Sagara, इति thus, एनम् him, अत्यजत् abandoned, रामः Rama, किं पापम् what sin, अकरोत् has committed, येन by which, एवम् this way,  उपरुध्यते should be banished.

40003736.author: Translation
40003736.content: Highly righteous king Sagara thus banished his son. What sin has Rama committed to secure a similar banishment?

40003737.author: पदार्थः
40003737.content: वयम् we, राघवस्य Rama's, अवगुणम् fault, कञ्चन even a little, न पश्यामः हि we do not see, शशाङ्कस्य moon's, कल्मषम् इव like stain, अस्य for this Rama, निरयः hell (blemish), दुर्लभः is difficult to find

40003737.author: Translation
40003737.content: We see no fault in Rama. Unlike the stain in the Moon it is difficult to find any  blemish in him.

40003738.author: पदार्थः
40003738.content: अथवा nevertheless, देवि Devi (Kaikeyi), त्वम् you, राघवे in the scion of the Raghu race (Rama), कञ्चित् the little, दोषम् fault, पश्यसि see, तम् about him, अद्य now, तत्त्वेन truly, ब्रूहि speak, तदा then, रामः Rama, विवास्यताम् will be exiled.

40003738.author: Translation
40003738.content: O Kaikeyi speak truly if you find any fault in this scion of the Raghu race (Rama). Then he will be exiled.

40003739.author: पदार्थः
40003739.content: अदुष्टस्य of an innocent, सत्पथे on the righteous path, निरतस्य च engaged in, संत्यागः  banishment, धर्मनिरोधनात् by restraining righteousness, शक्रस्य अपि even Indra's, द्युतिम्  brilliance, निर्दहेत् will be destroyed.

40003739.author: Translation
40003739.content: The act of banishment of an innocent one walking the righteous path is like destroying the brilliance of Indra by restraining his righteousness.

40003740.author: पदार्थः
40003740.content: देवि Devi, तत् for that reason, त्वया by you, रामस्य Rama's, श्रिया with prosperity, विहतया has been ruined, अलम् enough, शुभानने O one of auspicious countenance, ते to you, लोकतः in the world, परिवादः अपि censure also, रक्ष्यः हि is to be saved.

40003740.author: Translation
40003740.content: O Devi, there is no use obstructing Rama's prosperity. O one with an auspicious countenance, save yourself from the censure of the world.

40003741.author: पदार्थः
40003741.content: सिद्धार्थवचः Siddhartha's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा king, श्रान्ततरस्वनः in progressively failing voice, शोकोपहतया griefstricken, वाचा words, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40003741.author: Translation
40003741.content: Having heard Siddhartha, the king, stricken with grief, said to Kaikeyi in a gradually feeble voice.

40003742.author: पदार्थः
40003742.content: पापवृत्ते O one of vicious behaviour, एतत् वचः all these words, नेच्छसि do not please you, कुचेष्टा  of wicked attempts, कृपणम् vile, मार्गम् path, आस्थाय having adopted, मम to me, आत्मनो वा or to  you also, हितम् good, न जानासि you do not know, ते to you, चेष्टा actions, साधुपथात् from the right path, अपेता devoid

40003742.author: Translation
40003742.content: O Kaikeyi of vicious behaviour, you do not aceept even the words of Siddhartha. You woman of wicked acts, having adopted vile ways, and abjured the right path cannot know what is good either for you or for me.

40003743.author: पदार्थः
40003743.content: अहम् I, राज्यम् kingdom, सुखम् comfort, धनं च wealth, परित्यज्य forsaking, अद्य today, रामम् Rama, अनुव्रजिष्यामि shall follow, त्वम् you, राज्ञा with the king, भरतेन सहैव along with Bharata, यथासुखम् happily, चिराय for a long time, राज्यम् kingdom, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy.

40003743.author: Translation
40003743.content: Abandoning this kingdom, these comforts and this wealth, I shall follow Rama. Enjoy the kingdom for a long time happily along with king Bharata. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the thirtysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
